profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in building high performing, secure state of the art solutions with elevated user experience. Strong professional engineering background specialized in JavaScript. Active open-source software contributor.

GitHub: https://github.com/yohangz
Medium: https://medium.com/@yohan.gz

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
Successfully managed a frontend engineering team of 10+ members to achieve project objectives while guiding and providing them with necessary opportunities and resources for their career progression.

Continued conducting company-wide Frontend engineering initiatives. Chaired knowledge sharing sessions at EverythingJS, a company level JavaScript user group initiated by me. Supported many project teams by providing my expertise in frontend development and architecture designing.

Job Role: Envision the "right" technical approach to the solution/problem with a sense of the client's technical strategy.

Job responsibilities:
• Define the optimal solutions to meet client requirements & convince the stakeholders.
• Build and maintain a strong effective relationship with clients to ensure customer satisfaction and company growth.
• Involve in software design and Implementations with the creation of detailed software design specifications.
• Inspire, mentor, and encourage associates to intelligently apply the industry best practices with right customizations
• Estimations for various elements of projects, components etc.
• Support in defining and driving corporate technical vision/road-map aligning with global technology trends and standards.

Projects:
• Lightweight JavaScript library solution which has the capability of injecting recommendation widgets to retailer sites while capturing client user behaviors.
• Retailer product recommendation configuration web portal developed for a tier-one retailer in the USA.
• Comprehensive feature-rich retailer channel simulation content management system web portal solution for a tier-one retailer in the USA.

Technologies and tools used: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Jasmine, Mocha, Chai, Karma, Istanbul, Typedoc, Gulp, JS Hint, TS Lint, Bower, NPM, Yarn, PWA, RxJS, Angular, Angular Universal, Handlebars, Lodash, Node JS, Play Framework, Java, Docker, Travis, Webpack, Functional Programming, Reactive Programming

projects.title: Packer CLI
projects.description:
Packer CLI helps you to kickstart new node module projects compliant with NodeJS and Browser, prescribing best practices. Packer encapsulating file-watching, live-reloading, transpiling, bundling and unit test framework integration with coverage and much more, so you don’t have to. You will get to enjoy the latest JavaScript awesomeness with the flexibility to custom fit your project needs. Packer provides a generator ecosystem via command line to scaffold complete projects with full control over all exposed workflows.

Role: Project Initiator, Core Contributor, Architecture and Design, Development, Testing

Tools and technologies used: Node JS, NPM, Yarn, Travis CI, Babel, Typescript, TS List, ES Lint, Style Lint, Handlebars, SADD, LESS, Stylus, Post CSS, Prettier, Karma, Istanbul, Mocha, Chai, Jasmine, Jest, Rollup, Gulp, React, Enzyme JS

projects.title: Ornamentum
projects.description:
Lightweight, feature-rich, highly configurable, UI framework agnostic, fully responsive Angular data table with minimal dependencies.

Feature Overview;
• Client-side, server-side and realtime binding support.
• Single and multi-column sorting
• Single and multi-value filtering
• Custom layout templating support
• Data table state persistence with session/local storage modes
• Client and server-side pagination
• Single, multi and single toggle row selection modes
• UI theme support
• Column filter support
• Detail row expand support
• Experimental column resizing
• Experimental row grouping support
• Translation support and much more
• Global configuration overriding capability

Ornamentum is designed with a lot of flexibility in terms of configuring elements to the smallest detail level. It's a library designed by developers in the aim of building "A GREAT API".

UI framework agnostic hence it doesn't matter which UI framework is used. The fully configurable theme style sheets bundle provides several UI/UX flavors and extensive customizability out of the box.

Mobile-friendly with all major device platforms. From Desktop to Tablet and Mobile devices, Ornamentum is fully responsive for any viewport resolution. Dynamic behavior of width calculation works hand in hand along with static column sizes to provide the best user experience.

Supports server-side rendering with angular universal out of the box.

Reactive programming ready with asynchronous data streams. Data binding is fully handled via RXJS observable streams which accepts reactive data sources and use them under the hood for data operations. 

Role: Project Initiator, Core Contributor, Architecture and Design, Development, CI/CD Workflow, Deployment, Testing

Technologies and tools used: TypeScript, Angular, Angular Universal, Service Worker, Yarn, Jasmine, Karma, Express, Travis, Prettier, SCSS, SASS Lint, TS Lint, Lodash, Boostrap, RxJS, Prettier
